objective: The Hooks Store, job 12: the proven lane (SPEC 1.46, decision 39) after the carry-overs. Read SPEC.md at its current version in https://github.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec and jobs/next-job-carry-overs.md there (raw: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hook-store/hooks-store-spec/main/jobs/next-job-carry-overs.md) for the full wording and tests of every item below; every item is in scope. Carry-overs first. (h) The phantom scroll gap was fixed in job 10; keep its test: at 1920x1080 and 1366x768 with seven findings showing, the column's scrollHeight equals its last child's bottom plus the padding within 2 px, at load and after scrolling the column to its end. (i) The Builder goes fluid (3.2, decision 38): .builder-page.wrap takes max-width 1800px with padding-inline clamp(16px, 3vw, 48px) keeping the safe-area max() on each side; the .b2 grid keeps steps minmax(0, 1fr) and the card becomes clamp(420px, 28vw, 520px) from 1100 px up; rule rows, the shelf and fields fill their column; paragraph text keeps its 65ch measure; type sizes unchanged; the width sweep adds 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 asserting the content edges sit within the gutters up to 1800 px, no sideways scroll, the card inside the viewport. (j) Readable text (decision 41): keep Press Start 2P wherever it is used today; replace Pixelify Sans with Atkinson Hyperlegible for all reading text and VT323 with JetBrains Mono for numbers, addresses, hashes, signatures and the exact request text, same sizes and line heights, both self-hosted as latin woff2 under /fonts with licences in LICENSES and fallbacks declared, the old files and @font-face rules removed; a unit test on styles.css and Playwright assertions on computed font-family for a paragraph, a rule line, an address and the cost number on the Builder and the hook page at 390 and 1440 px. (k) A request id that is not a hook (decision 42): opening #hook/1/<request> for a contracts launch paid through the store (2454, 2456) without a connected wallet must reach the plain "Contracts launch <n>, live" page with its IMD explorer link, worded "Not a hook: a contracts launch for the store", not "Hook not found"; resolve the request from the chain's Requested event the way store bodies are indexed; Playwright covers the ads request id without a wallet. Then the job itself, SPEC 4.17 and 6.8. (1) Nearest match: when a draft has no exact proven match, matchProvenLaunch picks the proven launch of the same type (A, B or C) with the most block ids in common, ties to the newer launch, with at least one block in common besides token and own-token; the Builder line reads "Adapted from a proven launch: <name> (launch <n>, audited <date>): the swarm removes <blocks> and adds <blocks>"; the request sentence tells the swarm to start from that repository and commit, remove the named blocks and add the named blocks, then audit as a new hook; exact matches keep today's sentence. Unit tests for exact, nearest, tie and no-match, and that a words-only draft never matches. (2) Catalog and hook page marks: a launch in the proven index shows a PROVEN pill on its catalog card and hook page, with "Build one like this" preloading its blocks; the index is read exactly as today from evidence/proven-launches.json at the spec repository's raw URL (now updated by a scheduled script; the file's shape is unchanged, extra fields such as tokenAddress, deployerAddress, poolId and notes may be present and are ignored). (3) The wait line and the cost row read "Usually 30 to 90 minutes, sometimes up to 3 hours. From a proven launch, usually less." and, when a proven match exists, the card adds "This stack starts from audited code." (4) No instant lane, no factory, no free launch: the Builder offers exactly one launch, 0.5 IMD through the swarm; remove any copy that promised an instant lane. Tests: unit tests for (1) to (3); Playwright at 390x844, 1100x800 and 1920x1080 for a draft with a nearest match (the line, the request sentence, the sheet) and for a proven catalog card. Deliver source, dist/ and test results.
